tanitim.hero_baslik_1: From the floor to the office,
tanitim.hero_alt: MES + ERP for SME manufacturers. Live floor data unifies work orders, maintenance, inventory and quality in one dashboard.
tanitim.moduller_alt: From production to commerce, safety to intelligence. Every module speaks the same language: same button, same table, same control room.
tanitim.mod_uretim_ac: Machine status, OEE, work orders and a digital twin. Field readings reach the dashboard in seconds; critical machines read at a glance.
tanitim.mod_stok_ac: Held balances, critical-stock alerts and multi-line approval flow with separation of duties.
tanitim.mod_kalite_ac: Inspections, nonconformities and CAPA; energy consumption trended on a hypertable.
tanitim.mod_isgik_ac: Incidents, a 5×5 risk matrix, personnel, leave approvals and certificate tracking.
tanitim.mod_ticari_ac: CRM, a contract state machine, request management and a commercial dashboard.
tanitim.mod_dokuman_ac: Versioned document management (object storage) and real-time announcements.
tanitim.mod_zeka_ac: KPI dashboards, AI forecasts and PDF / XLSX report generation.
tanitim.mod_yonetim_ac: Users, roles and permissions, subscription and module entitlement, platform administration.
tanitim.nasil_baslik: From the floor to the dashboard, in seconds
tanitim.nasil_alt: A single data line from the edge device to the control room. Data is not lost even when the connection drops.
tanitim.adim_saha_ac: The edge agent collects readings from machines. If the link drops, store-and-forward keeps them, then delivers.
tanitim.adim_iletim_ac: Readings flow over MQTT to the ingestion worker, queued and de-duplicated.
tanitim.adim_isleme_ac: Production data becomes OEE. Modules publish events safely through an outbox.
tanitim.adim_kontrol_ac: Dashboard and kiosk update live over WebSocket, with no page refresh.
tanitim.persona_alt: A dashboard that shapes itself to the role: nobody drowns in data they do not need.
tanitim.persona_operator_ac: Status at a glance on a big screen: machine, OEE, work order and fault. Short attention, clear signal.
tanitim.persona_yonetici_ac: Cross-module data, dense filtered tables and period reports. One dashboard instead of scattered spreadsheets.
tanitim.persona_sorumlu_ac: Only their own modules and data. The warehouse lead sees their own panel, not the whole factory.
tanitim.platform_alt: The same solid ground for one plant or for many.
tanitim.plat_izolasyon_ac: Each plant in its own schema. Data never mixes in any query.
tanitim.plat_rbac_ac: Permission-based access. The requester cannot approve; sensitive fields are masked.
tanitim.plat_entitlement_ac: Turn modules on or off by plan and apply seat limits. Effect is instant.
tanitim.plat_dis_ac: Customers and suppliers reach a company-scoped, shell-less portal.
tanitim.plat_webhook_ac: Signed event delivery (HMAC) and scope-allowlisted API keys.
tanitim.plat_gerceklzaman_ac: WebSocket liveness, a WCAG 2.1 AA target, TR and EN interface.
tanitim.cta_alt: Connect to your factory's production intelligence. From the floor to the office, everything at a glance.

uyum.denetim_aciklama: Who did what, when, and on which record. Entries are immutable (append-only).
uyum.denetim_bos: No audit entries match your filters.
uyum.kvkk_aciklama: Personal data export, anonymization and consent records.
uyum.ihrac_aciklama: The selected person's personal data across all modules is packaged as a ZIP; download it once ready.
uyum.anonim_uyari: This action is IRREVERSIBLE: the person's identifying data is permanently masked. The operation is written to the audit log.
uyum.aydinlatma_kabul: I have read the privacy notice

uyum.ihrac_suresi_doldu: This export's retention period has ended; create a new request.

depo.alt: Stock by location and lot; transfers between locations
depo.bos_aciklama: Once stock is received, balances appear here by location and lot.

sayim.alt: Location counts; differences are added to the current balance on approval

sayim.onay_soru: {{sayi}} differing lines will be added to the current balance. Approve?
sayim.iptal_soru: Cancel this count? No difference will be applied.
sayim.delta_bilgi: On approval each line's difference (counted − system quantity when the line was opened) is added to the current balance; receipts and issues made during the count are kept. The approver must be someone other than the person who opened the count.

siparis.hedef_lokasyon_ipucu: Leave empty to book into MAIN / GENERAL.
siparis.lot_gerekli: This material is lot-tracked: enter a lot number
siparis.en_az_bir_kalem: Enter a quantity on at least one line
siparis.iade_tamam: Return recorded and deducted from stock
siparis.iptal_soru: Cancel this order? The request can be ordered again.

siparis.neden_gerekli: Enter a closing reason (at least 3 characters)
siparis.tedarikci_yok: No supplier-type companies yet. Add one in CRM.

aktarim.uygulanamadi: Could not apply. Preview the file again.

spc.cihazlar_alt: SPC measurements can't be entered with an instrument whose calibration isn't valid (ISO 9001 7.1.5).

spc.kullanilamaz_uyari: Measurements can't be entered with this instrument: calibration isn't valid or it's out of service. Enter a new calibration record.
spc.uygunsuz_notu: A failed result takes the instrument out of service until a new passing calibration.

spc.plan_bos_aciklama: Define the characteristics to measure for a product or operation.
spc.n_ipucu: How many parts are measured each round (2–10).

spc.kural_4: 8 points on one side of center

ik26.henuz_hak_yok: No annual leave accrues before the first service year is complete.
ik26.bakiye_tarihsiz: No hire date on file, so seniority and leave balance can't be calculated. Add it to the record.
ik26.bakiye_kurali: Leave accrues at each completed service year per Labour Law art. 53 (1–5 yrs 14, 6–14 yrs 20, 15+ yrs 26 days; at least 20 under 18 or over 50). Unused leave carries over; approved annual leave is deducted.
ik26.bakiye_asim: Request is {{talep}} days, balance is {{kalan}} days. It can't be approved.
ik26.acik_zimmet_uyari: {{adet}} assets are still assigned. "Assets returned" can't be checked until they're returned.
ik26.zimmet_kategori_ipucu: PPE handovers show up in the OHS missing-PPE report.
ik26.org_alt: Active staff by direct manager. Managers are assigned on the employee page.
ik26.org_ipucu: Click a person to open their record. Assignments that would create a loop are rejected.

isg26.alt_sayfa: OHS training sessions, the staff × topic validity matrix and PPE status by department.
isg26.konu_ipucu: The matrix and requirements match on topic.

isg26.matris_bos: No staff to show in the matrix.
isg26.kkd_bos: No PPE requirements defined. Add them under Requirements.
isg26.kkd_ipucu: PPE handover is logged as an asset with the "PPE" category on the employee page; once returned it shows as missing again.
isg26.tatbikat_alt: Fire, earthquake and evacuation drills: turnout, evacuation time and findings.
isg26.tahliye_ipucu: From the alarm to the final headcount at the assembly point.
isg26.bulgular_ornek: E.g. gate B was locked; the assembly point sign wasn't visible.
isg26.capa_soru: Open a CAPA case for this incident?
isg26.capa_aciklama: Severity follows the incident; the case is tracked under Nonconformities.

finans.fatura_alt: Sales and purchase invoices: prepared, issued by an approver, closed by payment.
finans.cari_alt: Balance per company. Positive: they owe us; negative: we owe them.
finans.odeme_alt: Receipts from companies and payments to companies.
finans.kendi_faturan: You prepared this invoice; another approver must issue it (separation of duties).
finans.aksiyon_tamam_kes: Invoice issued and posted to the account
finans.pdf_hata: Could not open the PDF; try again shortly

planlama.asim_baslik: {{n}} jobs cannot meet their due date in any order

planlama.elle_sira_ipucu: Lower numbers run first. Leave empty to sort by due date.

satis.alt: When a customer order is approved, material requirements are exploded from the bill of materials; production orders and a purchase request for shortages are opened automatically.
satis.hat_ipucu: Production orders opened on approval go to this machine.
satis.kendi_siparisin: Someone else must approve an order you created (segregation of duties).
satis.iptal_uyari: The draft order will be cancelled; this cannot be undone.
satis.iptal_onayli_uyari: The order will be cancelled. Production orders and the purchase request opened on approval are not closed automatically: the owning teams must close them.
satis.kullanilabilir_ipucu: On hand + incoming (open requests and orders) − reserved by open work orders
satis.recetesiz: {{n}} products have no bill of materials
satis.recetesiz_aciklama: A product without a BOM cannot be exploded, so the order cannot be approved. Define one under Products & BOM.
satis.mrp_bos: Material requirements could not be calculated for this order (no BOM).
satis.mrp_aciklama: Short = required − available. On approval a single purchase request is opened for the shortages and sent for purchasing approval.
satis.tetik_yok_taslak: Once the order is approved, production orders and, if needed, a purchase request appear here.
satis.tetik_yok: No work was opened for this order.
satis.onay_aciklama: A production order is opened on the selected line for each line item. The same order cannot be approved twice; repeating the trigger opens nothing new.
satis.onay_talep_acilacak: {{n}} materials are short: a purchase request will be opened for purchasing approval.

esg.alt: Scope 1 (fuel burned on site) and Scope 2 (purchased electricity) emissions from energy consumption; carbon and energy intensity per unit produced.
esg.aralik_hata: This range could not be calculated. Daily breakdown allows up to 92 days, monthly up to 3 years.
esg.faktorsuz_aciklama: These items have no emission factor; they were not counted as zero. Compressed air and water are produced with electricity; counting them again would double count. If it is another fuel, add a factor.
esg.veri_yok: No energy consumption in this range.
esg.faktor_aciklama: Default factors come from official sources (see the source column). When you enter your own factor, the default is no longer used for that type and unit; past periods are recalculated with the new factor.
esg.faktor_sil_soru: Delete this factor? Emissions will be recalculated.
esg.deger_ipucu: E.g. kg CO₂e per kWh for grid electricity.
esg.kaynak_ipucu: Where the factor comes from (body, document, year). Auditors will ask.
esg.rapor_ipucu: The ESG report (PDF) is prepared in the background; download it from:
